newsitem.title: USA: Parkvale raises div, sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Parkvale raises div, sets stock split.

text.p: Parkvale Financial Corp said on Wednesday that its board of directors has declared a five-for-four stock split and, in effect, raised the company's dividend 25 percent.
The stock split is payable October 14, 1996 to shareholders of record on September 30, 1996, Parkvale said. The number of shares will increase to 4,042,000 from 3,233,478, the company said.
The company's unchanged quarterly dividend rate of $0.13 a share will increase 25 percent because of the stock split, Parkvale said.
Parkvale said the dividend is payable October 24, 1996 to shareholders of record on October 15.
The company has had stock splits in 1995, 1994 and 1993, it said.
